title: MingCute Screenshot Quality Recovery batch 003
review_goal: Differentiate the next five MingCute message variants with screenshot grounded depicts and deterministic evidence fields.

items.depicts_observation: Rounded square speech bubble with two centered dots and a bottom notch
items.context_bias: Use when the interface needs a basic chat or message symbol with a two dot conversation cue.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for text document or notification cards when the visible form is clearly a speech bubble.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot shows a rounded square bubble with two interior dots and a small center notch below.

items.depicts_observation: Rounded square speech bubble with two dots and a spark star at upper right
items.context_bias: Use when the interface marks a conversation bubble as AI assisted automated or assistant generated.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for ordinary chat bubbles when the visible spark star cue is absent from the meaning.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot matches message_1 but adds a distinct spark star badge at the upper right corner.

items.depicts_observation: Square speech bubble outline with an open center and a bottom left tail
items.context_bias: Use when the interface needs a plain message bubble without text dots or extra assistant decoration.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for filled conversation states when the visible bubble interior is intentionally left empty.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot shows a simple square bubble outline with no dots and a tail offset to the lower left.

items.depicts_observation: Square speech bubble outline with a spark star at upper right and bottom tail
items.context_bias: Use when the interface needs an empty chat bubble that is specifically marked as assistant or AI related.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for standard message outlines when the visible spark star cue is not part of the meaning.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot mirrors message_2 but adds a spark star badge above the bubble at the upper right.

items.depicts_observation: Round speech bubble with two centered dots and a short lower tail
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a softer rounded conversation symbol rather than the square message variants.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the square bubble family when the visible circular outline is an important distinction.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot differs from message_1 by using a circular bubble body around the two interior dots.
